iti2:1.1: This was said by the Blessed One, said by the Arahant, so I have heard:
iti2:2.4: Abandon aversion as the one quality,
iti2:3.2: beings go to a bad destination,
iti2:3.3: upset: from rightly knowing that aversion,
iti2:3.4: those who see clearly let go. Letting go,
iti2:3.5: they never come to this world
